title: 地图充分匹配后先显示，藏品与资源继续补读

diagnosis.finding: Qualified maps previously waited for resource rereads and held-icon matching before becoming visible.
diagnosis.profile: Three 2052x1128 samples: run recognition 933-1603ms, held icons 467-765ms; complete OCR403-570ms. Diagnostic stage timings are not end-to-end latency.
diagnosis.change: Read map configuration first on qualified map pages, publish the matched map immediately, then finish existing resource and inventory work.
diagnosis.remaining: Complete text discovery and map configuration still precede map output; capture queue and painting add time. Inventory full recognition is unchanged.

implementation: Early maps require complete current text coverage, a qualified run map, matched topology, and neither a shop nor an expanded inventory page. Insufficient maps retain normal refinement.
The map stage carries current config and node content. Its reducer only applies those fields, leaving unread inventory/resources and their confirmation times untouched.
The in-flight frame remains pending. The complete result replaces its map stage at the same sequence; chronological replay retains one final history and prevents older pages replacing the current UI.
Same-frame HUD updates may follow a map stage. A later inventory failure retains the qualified map without inventing unread fields. Reset invalidates both stages.
Session recording labels partial map events as map_ready. No new model, dependency, speculative recovery or exception suppression.

method.capture: Real Windows.Graphics.Capture of isolated2052x1128 image-source window; elapsed source switch to correct Qt Paint.
method.baseline_source: All five changed production modules loaded from3844f0451 for baseline; prior current-frame-priority scheduler remains enabled. Legacy serial-a/b file labels do not mean single-worker execution.
method.context: Empty confirmed-config context tied to each isolated actual run id. Neutral-page warm-up, old page already reading at switch. Two paired rounds sequentially, no competing model tests.
method.accuracy: Complete observations compared after both readers drain. Only timings, capture timestamps and fixture run id excluded; texts, confidence, boxes, inventory, resources, config and maps compared.
method.limits: Historical independent page fixtures; not continuous real gameplay. Two rounds do not establish p95 or a universal500ms guarantee.

gold.method: 1280x800 real WGC and visible gold-chip Paint; two rounds of six consecutive known changes.

review.spec: Early map appears while inventory remains blocked; all six valid two-frame map/full interleavings equal full-only final state/history. Failed inventory leaves only qualified map facts. Late map/full after reset discarded.
review.code: Reviewed producer, reducer, timeline and GUI lifecycle separately. Existing config/map qualification is shared at one internal reducer; original public full-state validation remains. Callback owns a deep copy. Ordering and phase checks implement normal two-stage delivery. Existing speculative protections untouched; no new low-probability fallback.
review.publication: Explicit production/tests/records only; unrelated AGENTS.md, .agents, video, raw game images, private state and local logs excluded.

failed_or_limited_evidence: Behavior test first reproduced map waiting for inventory before the implementation.
First broad targeted run exposed12 outdated private _interpret test doubles without on_map; signatures updated without weakening assertions. Final160 passed.
One-round cold/hot control varied: initial map improved, hot returns did not. No startup or hot-cache speedup claimed.

First normal WM_CLOSE targeted compact toolbar, opening the full assistant without exiting. Then verified owning main window received normal close; updated original app reopened. No process killed or private record replaced.
Source gold round includes one577ms update. No guarantee for all resource updates.
Combined CPU over both reads increased in these small paired runs; early publication reduces waiting, not total computation. Game co-running frame-rate cost remains unmeasured.
remaining: Map still1.34-1.49s and expanded inventory2.38-2.50s in accepted comparisons; neither meets500ms.
Next targets: remove full text discovery from first useful map output where correctness permits, reduce icon matching work for first inventory output, and measure queue/GUI overhead.
No accepted real-game co-running, cold-start, lower-hardware, continuous short-page or all-resource500ms coverage.
